Georgia is famously known as the "Peach State," but despite its nickname, it is not the top producer of peaches in the U.S. Alabama, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania also produce peaches, but not in the largest quantities. South Carolina is a significant peach producer and sometimes even surpasses Georgia in annual production, but it is not the top producer overall.

California, on the other hand, produces by far the most peaches in the United States. In fact, California grows more than half of all peaches in the country, both for fresh consumption and for processing.
